name: useful why body
message:
Use polling for status updates

WebSockets require sticky sessions, which prevents requests from moving
between application servers.
diff:
diff --git a/status.py b/status.py
--- a/status.py
+++ b/status.py
@@ -1 +1,2 @@
-update_via_websocket(job)
+while job.pending:
+    poll(job)

sentences.text: WebSockets require sticky sessions, which prevents requests from moving between application servers.

name: allowed issue trailer
message:
Reject reused password tokens

Tokens are single-use so intercepted links cannot reset an account after
the owner has already changed the password.

Fixes #123
diff:
diff --git a/token.py b/token.py
--- a/token.py
+++ b/token.py
@@ -7 +7,2 @@
 reset(token)
+mark_used(token)

sentences.text: Tokens are single-use so intercepted links cannot reset an account after the owner has already changed the password.

name: test-only time-zone why body
message:
Make the added-date specs pass in any time zone

Only the test script pins New York time, so running jest directly or
from an editor in another zone failed the "today" check with a
misleading message.
diff:
diff --git a/date.test.ts b/date.test.ts
--- a/date.test.ts
+++ b/date.test.ts
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@
-const NOW = new Date('2026-11-23T03:00:00Z')
+const NOW = new Date('2026-11-23T17:00:00Z')
+expect(process.env.TZ).toBe('America/New_York')

sentences.text: Only the test script pins New York time, so running jest directly or from an editor in another zone failed the "today" check with a misleading message.

name: refactor why body with domain nouns
message:
Decide edit access once, in the referrer section

The section already knows the user's permissions and which practices
were created in this form, so it now hands the card a yes or no
instead of the card asking the user context again. The card no longer
needs a signed-in user to render, which keeps its specs to props.
diff:
diff --git a/section.tsx b/section.tsx
--- a/section.tsx
+++ b/section.tsx
@@ -1 +1 @@
-<Card />
+<Card canEdit={hasEditPermission} />

sentences.text: The section already knows the user's permissions and which practices were created in this form, so it now hands the card a yes or no instead of the card asking the user context again.
The card no longer needs a signed-in user to render, which keeps its specs to props.
